notes.title: DEMO for "MOAI 2: Path to Another World" is available now!
notes.content:
[h1]Friends,[/h1]
We are glad to announce that [b]Demo version[/b] for  [b]"MOAI 2"[/b]  added  on Steam now!
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/361950/][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/361950/header.jpg?t=1438031550[/img][/url]
Are you not sure that you will like it?  Try the DEMO - and make a right choice!;)

[h1]P.S.[/h1] 
[i]And don't forget about opportunity to play DEMO for 1st game [b]"MOAI: Build Your Dream"![/b][/i]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/338980/][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/338980/header.jpg?t=1438031479[/img][/url]
